label.zh: 通过虫洞现身 / 一般首次接触

note.zh: 3505：天选民舰队通过虫洞进入尚未建立联络的帝国领地；3515：在天选民系统发生首次接触。二者都以灭绝战争收场。
note.en: 3505: the Chosen's fleet jumps through a wormhole into an empire without comms; 3515: ordinary first contact in the chosen system. Both end in a cleansing war.

notes.zh: 入口隐藏事件 fircon.3500 生成天选民家园系统（距离30–75，向边缘方向，无超空间航道）；3505 为虫洞触发（隐藏），向所有有情报的玩家国家发出本事件。
notes.en: Hidden entry fircon.3500 spawns the Chosen home system (distance 30-75, rimwards, no hyperlane); hidden 3505 (on_entering_wormhole) sends this event to every empire with intel.

scope.zh: 天选民：被隐藏的帝国从虫洞现身，邻国得知并被宣战；或首次接触时被宣战。
scope.en: The Chosen: a hidden empire emerges through a wormhole and declares cleansing war on contact.

uncertain: fircon.3500 is fired by a random branch of ancrel.12050 (an ancient-relics story owned by another reviewer); recorded here only as the entry.
